## Decision

Decided by Hari on 2026-10-22. Recognised under docs/agents/factory.md "Item lifecycle" step 3 for #114. Hari approved recording this narrow amendment in the implementing session.

Amend the checked Revision 2 plan in comment 6321098789, "Persistent run storage and durable protocol", by replacing its durable-store phrase `no write retry` with:

> No Runner-initiated write retry. The required Azure CLI may retain its pinned SDK's internal conditional-request retries inside the existing 60-second CLI and 180-second store-operation deadlines. A CLI 412/conflict always stops advancement, including when an earlier request may have committed. Other uncertain CLI outcomes retain the existing three bounded readbacks with delays of 1 and 2 seconds. No conflicting write is merged or reinvoked.

A lost response can therefore leave a committed transition reported as a conflict, halting the phase rather than advancing. Preserve reservations and available evidence. Add no identity, credential provider, package, lease, repeat or live operation. The actual CLI version/help receipts and all existing deployment acceptance remain required.

Apply the [reviewable amendment proposal](https://github.com/collaborationwithothers/eventhubs-kafka-dotnet/blob/831e171d688870abc7b393f9e652dc9b84e1c603/docs/operations/evidence/issue-114/retry-amendment-proposal.md): update the class summary and operational contract to distinguish Runner calls from SDK requests, preserve conflict-stop and exact-byte readback assertions, then obtain the next cold review before an ordinary push. Required exact-head full verification still comes from the existing PR workflow.

This amends the contract behind cold-review-12's retry P1; the original source finding remains historical evidence. It does not resolve or reclassify the separate disputed sweeper P0. All other selected-plan requirements and decision 6333713470 remain unchanged.
